annotations.title: Due diligence on an ACP provider

description: Due diligence on an ACP provider before hiring it: does it finish the work, who said the work was done, who pays it, is the record current, who is behind it, is it on a sanctions list. Each answer has a status and what would settle it. No score and never a statement that the agent is safe. `applies` is false for an address with no paid ACP job and judged completion, and that is not a finding about the agent. ACP is read on Base only.

address.description: The ACP provider you are about to hire.
